lines.en: label convenience1:
scene black
scene nightsky
A sudden desire to go somewhere far away washes over me.
lines.zh: 一种想跑去很远的地方的冲动突然涌上心头。

lines.en: I’m not sure what brings it on, but I guess that really ties into the word “sudden,” now doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 我不知道是什么引起的，不过我想这恰恰印证了「突然」这个词，不是吗？

lines.en: sud-den (sədn) {i}adjective{/i} - occurring or done quickly and unexpectedly or without warning.
lines.zh: sud-den（sədn）{i}形容词{/i}——发生或完成得迅速而出乎意料，或毫无预警。

lines.en: scene happy5
scene tree3
scene happy4
scene happy3
scene nightsky
Sudden.
lines.zh: 突然。

lines.en: Definitions can be fun if you’re willing to swim through all of the words you don’t like.
lines.zh: 只要你愿意在你不喜欢的一大堆词里游过去，定义也可以很有趣。

lines.en: What are some words you don’t like?
lines.zh: 你有什么不喜欢的词吗？

lines.en: Tell me.
lines.zh: 告诉我。

lines.en: I’m excited to hear them.
lines.zh: 我很期待听到。

lines.en: scene tree3
scene firstconvenience1
Sudden.
lines.zh: 突然。

lines.en: I wind up at an unfamiliar convenience store in the blink of an eye.
lines.zh: 一眨眼之间，我就站在了一家陌生的便利店里。

lines.en: I have...absolutely no idea how I got here or where in town this even is, but...I guess I’m going to buy a drink or something.
lines.zh: 我……完全不知道自己是怎么来的，也不知道这到底是城里的哪里，但……我想我就买瓶饮料什么的吧。

lines.en: A [young_girl] sits at the counter and-
lines.zh: 一个[young_girl]坐在收银台后面，然后——

lines.en: Wait. Isn’t that Noriko?
lines.zh: 等等。那不是 Noriko 吗？

lines.en: I’ve definitely heard her mention having a job before, and I guess something like a convenience store is suited to girls her age.
lines.zh: 我确实听她提过自己有份工作，而且我想便利店这种地方挺适合她这个年纪的女孩。

lines.en: But it’s just all so sudden.
lines.zh: 但这实在来得太突然了。

lines.en: I wonder if maybe I can take advantage of how much she likes me to get a discount on stuff?
lines.zh: 我在想，能不能利用她对我的好感，顺便要点折扣？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience2
: Hey. How’s it going?
lines.zh: : 嘿。怎么样啊？

lines.en: : Can I help you?
lines.zh: : 需要帮忙吗？

lines.en: : What, you don’t recognize my voice?
lines.zh: : 怎么，你听不出我的声音吗？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience3
: If you’re here to start trouble, I-
lines.zh: : 如果你是来找麻烦的，我——

lines.en: scene firstconvenience4
: Ah! Sensei! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sensei！你在这儿干什么？！

lines.en: : Did Nee-chan tell you where I worked?
lines.zh: : 是姐姐告诉你我在哪儿工作的吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Just coincidentally happened to stumble in here.
lines.zh: : 没有。只是碰巧逛进来的。

lines.en: : Ahh! That’s so great!
lines.zh: : 啊！太好了！

lines.en: : I’m glad we got our reunion out of the way in the classroom first, because breaking down behind the counter and confessing in front of the onigiri wouldn’t have been a good look for me.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴我们已经在教室里先把重逢这关过了，因为要是我在收银台后面当场崩溃、对着饭团告白，那可太难看了。

lines.en: : Sure, I’ll take the hit to all of my current relationships so the rice balls don’t think you’re weird.
lines.zh: : 行，那我就算牺牲现在所有的人际关系，也得让饭团们不觉得你奇怪。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience5
: Heheh~ Thanks!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 谢谢！

lines.en: : You sure you weren’t over here looking for me, though?
lines.zh: : 不过你确定你不是专程来找我的吗？

lines.en: : The old district seems like it’s kind of far from[school] to just show up in all coincidentally and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 老城区离[school]好像有点远，不至于就这么「碰巧」出现在这里什么的吧。

lines.en: : We’re all the way in the old district?
lines.zh: : 我们居然在老城区？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience6
: Wait, is this another memory thingy?
lines.zh: : 等等，这又是一次记忆之类的东西吗？

lines.en: : Are you sure it’s not Alzheimer’s?
lines.zh: : 你确定不是老年痴呆？

lines.en: : Pretty positive.
lines.zh: : 相当确定。

lines.en: : Are you really commuting from the dorms to the old district every day for work?
lines.zh: : 你真的每天从宿舍跑到老城区上班？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience7
: Yup! But I normally just take an Uber so it’s not like it’s crazy far.
lines.zh: : 对啊！不过我一般是打车，所以也没远到离谱。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you can afford that.
lines.zh: : 我挺惊讶你付得起。

lines.en: : I still make money running errands for my sister every weekend, so I’m not totally broke.
lines.zh: : 我每个周末还靠给姐姐跑腿赚钱，所以也不算彻底破产。

lines.en: : Our parents are pretty well off now, too. Their business really took off a couple years ago.
lines.zh: : 我爸妈现在也挺有钱的。他们的生意几年前突然起飞了。

lines.en: : Is their business a thing I knew about?
lines.zh: : 他们的生意是我以前知道的吗？

lines.en: : They were just starting it up around the time you disappeared, so you probably knew a little bit about it at least.
lines.zh: : 大概是你消失那会儿他们刚起步，所以你至少应该知道一点。

lines.en: : It’s just some Chinese restaurant thingy near my old[school]. If you’d like, I can take you there sometime?
lines.zh: : 就在我以前的[school]附近的一家中华料理店而已。如果你愿意，我什么时候带你去？

lines.en: : I’m sure they’d be happy to see you.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定他们见到你会很高兴。

lines.en: : Maybe after I remember a little more about them.
lines.zh: : 也许等我多想起一点关于他们的事之后吧。

lines.en: Assuming that ever happens.
lines.zh: 假如那天真的会来的话。

lines.en: Which it likely won’t.
lines.zh: 但很可能不会。

lines.en: But, then again, I just happened to find this place out of nowhere tonight, so I wouldn’t say it’s entirely out of the question to find somewhere else just like it.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我今晚也是莫名其妙就找到了这地方，所以我也不好说，找到另一个同样的地方就完全不可能。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience8
: Hmm...
: What? What is that look?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你那是什么表情？

lines.en: : I was just thinking that maybe your conscience led you here in search of me.
lines.zh: : 我只是在想，也许是你的良心把你带到这儿来找我的。

lines.en: : What if your memories are trying to speak to you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 万一你的记忆正试图跟你说话呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : Can you hear them shouting “Noriko! Noriko!” or something like that?
lines.zh: : 你能听到它们在喊「Noriko！Noriko！」什么的吗？

lines.en: : All I hear is a really loud song on the radio.
lines.zh: : 我只听到收音机里放着一首特别吵的歌。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience9
: The radio’s not even on, though. Are you sure you’re feeling okay?
lines.zh: : 可是收音机根本没开啊。你确定你没事吗？

lines.en: : Do you want a rice ball?
lines.zh: : 要不要来个饭团？

lines.en: : One of the sentient ones that judge you based on how you react to reuniting with a long lost love interest? No thanks.
lines.zh: : 那种有自我意识、会根据你和失散多年的恋人重逢时的反应来评判你的饭团？不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: : I prefer my food to not have a mind of its own.
lines.zh: : 我比较希望我的食物没有自己的思想。

lines.en: : So, what? You don’t eat yogurt either then?
lines.zh: : 那怎么着？那你连酸奶也不吃了？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Yogurt. The thick sour white stuff full of living organisms that {i}doesn’t{/i} come out of a penis.
lines.zh: : 酸奶啊。那又稠又酸、白花花的、满是活体微生物、又{i}不{/i}是从鸡巴里出来的东西。

lines.en: : Yogurt is alive?
lines.zh: : 酸奶是活的？

lines.en: : Yeah. And not only is it alive, it can {i}feel{/i}.
lines.zh: : 对。而且它不只是活的，它还有{i}感觉{/i}。

lines.en: : You’re shitting me.
lines.zh: : 你在逗我吧。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience10
: I am not!
lines.zh: : 我才没有！

lines.en: : We watched a video in one of my old science classes where a bunch of researchers hooked a thing of yogurt up to a machine and then yelled at it and it got {i}scared{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我以前的一节科学课上看过一个视频，一群研究人员把一盒酸奶接到机器上，然后对着它大吼，它就{i}害怕{/i}了。

lines.en: : Or at least reacted in a way that emulated some level of fear. I guess it’s not technically possible to prove whether or not it actually {i}did{/i} display the more human type of fear.
lines.zh: : 或者说，它的反应至少模拟出了某种程度的恐惧。我想，严格来说也没法证明它是不是{i}真的{/i}表现出了更像人类的那种恐惧。

lines.en: : I’d like to meet whoever decided to hook yogurt up to a machine and yell at it. They sound very interesting.
lines.zh: : 我真想见见那个决定把酸奶接到机器上冲它吼的人。听起来挺有意思的。

lines.en: : Hey, are we gonna do any cool experiments like that in your class, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们会在你的课上做这种酷酷的实验吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : We’re not going to do anything in my class ever.
lines.zh: : 在我的课上，我们永远不会做任何事。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience11
: Wait, ever? Why?
lines.zh: : 等等，永远？为什么？

lines.en: : That’s just not how I teach.
lines.zh: : 我教书的方式就不是那样的。

lines.en: : Did something happen? You used to love teaching.
lines.zh: : 发生什么事了吗？你以前很喜欢教书的。

lines.en: : Like, sure there were days where you’d get all upset and mopey and just have us do worksheets, but everyone gets days like that.
lines.zh: : 比如说，当然也会有你心情不好、闷闷不乐、只让我们做练习卷的日子，但谁都会有那种日子。

lines.en: : Well, without the worksheets. I think that’s a thing specific to tutors and teachers and stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯，除了练习卷。我觉得那是家教和老师之类的专属。

lines.en: : You can mess around with the science equipment if you want, just don’t burn the classroom down.
lines.zh: : 你想玩科学器材就随便玩，只是别把教室烧了。

lines.en: : Ami did something like that once and I’m pretty sure several of the girls had a near-brush with death as a result.
lines.zh: : Ami 以前干过类似的事，我敢肯定好几个女孩因此差点没命。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience12
: Hell yeah. That’s what I like to hear.
lines.zh: : 太他妈对了。我就爱听这个。

lines.en: : I’m a little upset that you won’t be doing any {i}actual{/i} teaching anymore, but I guess I’m already way ahead of most other girls my age anyway.
lines.zh: : 你以后再也不{i}真正{/i}讲课了，我有点难过，不过我想我本来就已经比同龄的大多数女孩超前很多了。

lines.en: : Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience5
: What? Are you surprised?
lines.zh: : 什么？你很惊讶？

lines.en: : I’m not sure yet. How ahead are you, exactly?
lines.zh: : 我还不确定。你到底超前多少？

lines.en: : I had the second highest standardized test score in my entire grade at my last[school].
lines.zh: : 我在上一所[school]时，标准考试分数是全年级第二名。

lines.en: : Pretty cruel twist of fate, too, since I wound up transferring into Wakana’s class right beside the girl who beat me.
lines.zh: : 而且命运也挺残酷的，因为我转学进了 Wakana 的班，就坐在那个赢了我的女孩旁边。

lines.en: : Yup. Now I’m definitely a little surprised.
lines.zh: : 嗯。现在我确实有点惊讶了。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience7
: Don’t judge books by their covers, Sensei. Especially when the books are in love with you and filled with lots of embarrassing secrets.
lines.zh: : 别以貌取人啊，Sensei。尤其是当那些「书」爱上了你，还塞满了让人难堪的秘密的时候。

lines.en: : And I’m assuming you’re going to weaponize those secrets as soon as it becomes convenient for you to do so?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，一旦时机合适，你就会把这些秘密武器化？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience13
: What? No. Of course not.
lines.zh: : 什么？不。当然不会。

lines.en: : I have nothing to gain by embarrassing you in public. Which is why I also agree to start changing my wardrobe if I attract too much attention and you hate it.
lines.zh: : 当众让你难堪对我一点好处都没有。所以我也同意，如果我太惹眼而你不喜欢，我就开始换衣服。

lines.en: : I realize some of my clothes can be a little...uhh...flashy?
lines.zh: : 我知道我有些衣服可能有点……呃……花哨？

lines.en: : Is that what the kids are calling it nowadays?
lines.zh: : 现在的年轻人是这么叫的吗？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience14
: Or, as my sister would say, {i}trashy, tactless, and immeasurably undesirable.{/i}
lines.zh: : 或者，按我姐姐的说法，{i}廉价、没品味、而且极其不受欢迎{/i}。

lines.en: : {i}The complete opposite of what a girl should look like.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}完全是一个女孩该有的样子的反面。{/i}

lines.en: scene firstconvenience5
: Or something.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : But, little does she know, this is all part of my patented strategy to show her that you can obtain everything you want in life without signing away your soul to do it.
lines.zh: : 但她不知道的是，这都是我独家策略的一部分，我要向她证明：你不需要出卖灵魂，也能得到人生中想要的一切。

lines.en: : I will live free and dangerously in complete contrast to the name “Noriko!”
lines.zh: : 我要活得自由又危险，彻底和「Noriko」这个名字背道而驰！

lines.en: : You do that. Just don’t get yourself into any trouble.
lines.zh: : 你尽管去。只是别给自己惹上麻烦。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience15
: Yes, Sir. I’ll be a good girl.
lines.zh: : 是，长官。我会做个好女孩的。

lines.en: : I mean, look at me now. I’ve already got a job. Two jobs if you count all of the PA stuff, and my grades are awesome.
lines.zh: : 我是说，看看现在的我。我已经有工作了。要是把助理的那些活儿也算上就是两份，而且我的成绩也超棒。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience16
: And, to top it all off, I get to spend at least seven hours of every day with the man of my dreams.
lines.zh: : 而且最棒的是，我每天至少能有七个小时和我梦中的男人待在一起。

lines.en: : This is the happiest I’ve been in a long time, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这是我这么久以来最幸福的时候了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t even care that Maya looks like she’s going to slit my throat every time our eyes accidentally meet.
lines.zh: : 就连每次我们目光不小心对上、Maya 一脸要割了我喉咙的表情，我都不在乎。

lines.en: : Thankfully, I don’t think Maya carries around a pocket knife like some other girl I know.
lines.zh: : 幸好，我觉得 Maya 不会像我认识的另一个女孩那样随身带折叠刀。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: : I’m so happy you’re back.
lines.zh: : 你回来了，我真的好开心。

lines.en: : I know I keep saying it, but I really am.
lines.zh: : 我知道我一直在说，但我真的就是这样。

lines.en: : The more times you say it, the worse I will feel for remembering literally none of it.
lines.zh: : 你说得越多，我就越为「一点都记不起来」而难受。

lines.en: : You’ll remember. I know you will.
lines.zh: : 你会想起来的。我知道你会。

lines.en: : There’s probably just some sort of...inhibitor that was implanted in your brain by aliens or something like that.
lines.zh: : 大概只是外星人什么的往你脑子里植入了某种……抑制剂之类的东西。

lines.en: : Is that what the space war is all about?
lines.zh: : 太空战争就是为了这个吗？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience17
: Mmm...no. I’m pretty sure that was an economic thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不是。我挺确定那是经济方面的原因。

lines.en: What the hell is happening with the Japanese economy that provoked a war in space?
lines.zh: 日本经济到底出了什么事，居然引发了太空战争？

lines.en: : At least it would make sense for it to be. It’s not like wars have never been started for money before.
lines.zh: : 至少那样才说得通。为了钱而发动的战争又不是没有过。

lines.en: : In fact, war itself is a major money maker for a lot of different industries and helps bolster political favor for the powerful people neck deep inside of them.
lines.zh: : 事实上，战争本身就是许多行业的摇钱树，还能替那些深陷其中的权贵巩固政治上的好处。

lines.en: : I agree and understand exactly what we are talking about.
lines.zh: : 我完全同意，也完全明白我们在说什么。

lines.en: : Is the ailing economy the same reason you got a job as well, Noriko?
lines.zh: : 那不景气的经济也是你去找工作的原因吗，Noriko？

lines.en: scene firstconvenience5
: Nah, I was just bored since Nee-chan only needs help on the weekends.
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是闲得慌，因为姐姐只有周末才需要帮忙。

lines.en: : I mean, I could have probably gone and worked at my parents’ restaurant, but being independent feels a lot better.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我本来也可以去我爸妈的餐厅干活，但独立的感觉好多了。

lines.en: : And also, they started looking at me weirdly ever since I told them I was in love with you. Whoops.
lines.zh: : 而且自从我告诉他们我爱上你以后，他们看我的眼神就怪怪的。哎呀。

lines.en: : Why on earth did you do that? And how did this whole love thing even happen?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么要那么说？还有这整件「爱」的事究竟是怎么发生的？

lines.en: : Which one of those do you want me to answer first?
lines.zh: : 你想让我先回答哪一个？

lines.en: : The latter one. I’m just going to assume you told your parents because of an alien implant. I like that excuse and will be using it frequently.
lines.zh: : 后一个。我就当你告诉父母是因为外星人植入了芯片。我喜欢这个借口，以后会经常用。

lines.en: : Ooooh, nice callback.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，呼应得不错。

lines.en: : But...love just happens, you know?
lines.zh: : 不过……爱就是这么发生的，你懂吧？

lines.en: : We were alone together a lot back in the day. And I thought you were super cool.
lines.zh: : 以前我们经常单独待在一起。而且我觉得你特别酷。

lines.en: : Saying I’ve “loved” you since I was six is probably a bit of a stretch. I imagine it was something more akin to just pure admiration at first.
lines.zh: : 说我六岁起就「爱」上你，可能有点夸张。我想一开始更像是纯粹的崇拜。

lines.en: : But it’s not uncommon for admiration to turn into something more once your thoughts on romance and sex develop.
lines.zh: : 不过，等你关于恋爱和性的想法慢慢成形，崇拜变成更进一步的感情也并不罕见。

lines.en: : Now, here I am in [high_school] thinking about what it would be like to grow old and take over my family’s business with you.
lines.zh: : 而现在，我人在[high_school]，却在想着和你一起变老、一起接手我家生意会是什么样。

lines.en: : What now? You want to call me crazy again?
lines.zh: : 又怎么了？你又想说我疯了？

lines.en: : I can take it. I’ve heard it plenty of times.
lines.zh: : 我受得了。这话我听多了。

lines.en: : Nah. You’re just really cute.
lines.zh: : 不。你只是真的很可爱。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience18
: Stop...you’re going to make me blush.
lines.zh: : 别说了……你会让我脸红的。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience19
: Hey, man! If you’re gonna be my second in command, you’re gonna at least have to clean the bathrooms or something.
lines.zh: : 嘿，老兄！你要是想当我的二把手，至少得去打扫洗手间什么的。

lines.en: : Just hire Ami instead of me. I’m sure she’ll gladly do it if I’m involved in any way.
lines.zh: : 你直接雇 Ami 别雇我。只要跟我沾边，她肯定乐意干。

lines.en: scene firstconvenience20
: Oh! Then it will be like, a {i}double{/i} family business! The Nakayamas and the Arakawas coming together as one! Serving fried rice to all of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 哦！那就像是，{i}双{/i}家族企业！Nakayama 家和 Arakawa 家合二为一！为整个 Kumon-mi 献上炒饭！

lines.en: : The Arakawayamas! The Nakakawas!
lines.zh: : Arakawayama 家！Nakakawa 家！

lines.en: : The Nakayarakawayamas!
lines.zh: : Nakayarakawayama 家！

lines.en: : Please calm down, Noriko...
lines.zh: : 冷静点，Noriko……

lines.en: scene firstconvenience15
: Yes, Sir. I’ll be a good girl.
lines.zh: : 是，长官。我会做个好女孩的。

lines.en: : Besides, we don’t have to do something like that if it’s not a future you want for yourself.
lines.zh: : 再说了，如果那不是你想要的未来，我们也不必非得那么做。

lines.en: : Anything is possible in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 在 Kumon-mi 什么都有可能。

lines.en: : Like, if {i}Nee-chan{/i} can become a top idol when all she did up until she was 18 was doodle anime characters, I'm sure the two of us can explore some options.
lines.zh: : 比如说，既然{i}姐姐{/i}在十八岁之前只会涂涂画画动画角色也能当上顶流偶像，那我相信我们俩也能摸索出点路子。

lines.en: : If...you ever want to do that, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……如果你有朝一日想那么做的话。

lines.en: : Obviously, there’s more than one person fighting for your affection right now.
lines.zh: : 显然，现在正在争夺你的心的不止一个人。

lines.en: : But remember that...even if you forget me now, everything will come flooding back eventually.
lines.zh: : 但请记住……就算你现在忘记了我，总有一天一切都会像潮水一样涌回来。

lines.en: : And when that happens, know you can count on me to be everything you’ll ever need.
lines.zh: : 到那一天，请你相信，我可以成为你需要的一切。

lines.en: scene black
The way I leave the convenience store is a lot less sudden (sədn) than how I arrived.
lines.zh: 我离开这家便利店的方式，可比我到来时——sudden（sədn）——要不突然得多。

lines.en: Noriko and I wind up chatting for another hour or two about random things that pop into her head and, just as always, I have a hard time understanding why Maya hates her as much as she does.
lines.zh: Noriko 和我又聊了一两个小时，聊的都是她脑子里冒出来的乱七八糟的东西，而和往常一样，我还是很难理解 Maya 为什么那么讨厌她。

lines.en: She’s smart, extremely kind, good at holding a conversation, and even {i}did{/i} give me a discount on a [[non-sentient] rice ball as I left.
lines.zh: 她聪明、极其善良、很会聊天，而且我走的时候，她{i}甚至{/i}给一个[[non-sentient] 饭团打了折。

lines.en: But I feel like there’s something else to her that I can’t quite put my finger on yet.
lines.zh: 但我觉得她身上还有某种我说不太清楚的东西。

lines.en: I feel the same way when looking at sculptures.
lines.zh: 我看雕塑的时候也有同样的感觉。

lines.en: There’s too much perfection on the outside for everything to possibly be the same once you work your way in.
lines.zh: 外表太过完美，等你一路探究进去，里面就不可能还是一样的了。

lines.en: Just the insides of sculptures are pure stone or marble-
lines.zh: 只不过雕塑的内部是纯粹的石头或大理石——

lines.en: And the insides of Noriko are a lot less beautiful.
lines.zh: 而 Noriko 的内部，可就没那么美了。

{i}Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Noriko 的好感度提升到了 [noriko_love]!{/i}
